# clsx (vendored)

Tiny utility for conditionally joining className strings.

- Upstream: https://github.com/lukeed/clsx
- Pinned version: v2.1.1 (source pulled from the `v2.1.1` git tag on 2026-04-19)
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

`index.ts` is the upstream `src/index.js` re-typed as TypeScript, preserving
the original implementation verbatim. The type definitions come from upstream
`clsx.d.mts`.

To update: copy `src/index.js` and `clsx.d.mts` from a newer upstream tag,
re-merge into `index.ts`, and bump the pinned-version line above.
